materials.name: DS-7409

thickness_range.steps_note: Other sheet sizes and thicknesses on request

materials.notes: ANSI grade FR-4, high Tg (above 170), UV blocking and AOI compatible. Standard values for a 1.6 mm specimen: Tg 170 C DSC and 160 C TMA (guaranteed above 160 and 155 C); Dk 4.5-4.8 and Df 0.015-0.020 at 1 MHz; peel strength 1.6-1.8 kgf/cm (1 oz foil, guaranteed above 1.43); flexural strength 40-50 kgf/mm2; water absorption 0.10-0.14 %; solder float at 260 C above 180 s. Resistivities and insulation resistance are given as ranges and are not stored. UL file E103670. Standard tolerance on sheet size +3/-0 mm.
